description: Sort a playlist in place by added_at/name/artist/duration. Quota: GET all + PUT/POST. popularity is not a sort key: the API no longer returns it on playlist items.

dry_run.description: Preview only: validate inputs and describe exactly what would change without performing it

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

playlist_id.description: Playlist ID, spotify:playlist: URI, or URL

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

sort_by.description: Sort key applied to the playlist

name: playlist_sort
